purpose: Freeze statistical decision rules and benchmark sensitivity diagnostics for future LM curation studies without changing the observed selector or reinterpreting external neutral evidence as gain.
claim_boundary: This protocol governs future evidence collection. It does not upgrade the current code-domain claim and does not authorize a Stage-B policy change.

frozen_outcome_isolation.utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective

equal_token_primary.decision_rule: Predeclare one primary metric family per deployment contract. Report the paired point estimate and interval; a positive point estimate alone is insufficient when the interval crosses the practical margin.

natural_budget_supporting.claim_boundary: Natural-budget evidence describes training-cost and retained-performance tradeoffs. It does not isolate the Stage-B selection effect.

external_transfer.benchmark_role: frozen independent guardrail and transfer sensitivity check
external_transfer.current_evidence_role: The completed 48-task LiveCodeBench confirmation is a limitation report because it is below the powered task-count rule.

sensitivity_matrix: model_capability: target_model and one larger-model sensitivity only when the target model is floor_or_ceiling_limited
benchmark_difficulty: frozen strata with all task rows retained
randomness: identical frozen seed set across compared arms
forbidden_uses: using any Stage-C metric, CI, benchmark, or sensitivity outcome in Stage B
selecting a metric family after observing the treatment effect
claiming external transfer from an underpowered or floor-ceiling-limited benchmark
using natural-budget results as sole evidence of selector-specific benefit
